body: Create an animation-ready modular 2D cel shaded fantasy game cutout atlas, Arcane Vanguard style, bold clean dark outlines, painterly cel shading, detailed but readable at small size. Landscape high-resolution image on TRUE transparent alpha. SIX separate equally sized panels arranged THREE columns TWO rows. View directions reading order: E right profile, SE front-right threequarter, SW front-left threequarter, W left profile, NW rear-left threequarter, NE rear-right threequarter. Rear views show BACK of skull/hair, BACK of clothing, no face or front chest ornament. Every panel contains exactly12 ISOLATED BODY PIECES in3columns4rows, consistent local ordering: row1 head, upper torso from neck to waist ONLY, rear cape; row2 pelvis/skirt, anatomical left upperarm, right upperarm; row3 left forearm including hand, right forearm including hand, left leg without foot; row4 right leg without foot, left boot, right boot. No full figures. Head entirely detached from torso. Arms split at elbows. Legs stop at ankles. NO equipment or effects in body sheet. Large transparent gutters between every cutout and everypanel. Avoid labels, checkerboard, background, panels, borders. Do not connect pieces. Full consistent identity across six genuine rotations. Subject: Regal Lich King, bare ivory skull face with glowing green eyes, tall tarnished GOLD spiked crown, black robes with long PURPLE central panel and gold diamond ornaments, bone hands and bone neck, dramatic black mantle. Crown remains separate with head. Royal powerful skull sorcerer.
equipment: Equipment-only cutout atlas. SIX isolated magic STAFFS, no people, no skull characters, no robes, no hands. True transparent background. 3 columns2 rows: rightprofile,front-right,front-left,leftprofile,rear-left,rear-right. Every cell contains ONLY one tall ebony wooden staff with GREEN faceted soul crystal held in small gold metal claws at top. Full shaft visible. Painterly cel shaded fantasy game equipment with crisp dark outline. No haze or glow background. No text. Six weapons only.
effects: Transparent 2D hand-painted cel shaded fantasy GAME VFX SPRITESHEET. Exactly8columns4rows,32 individual animation frames. Each row one8frame left-to-right animation. Large transparent gutters between frames and rows. All cells same size, effect centered, frame0 small beginning then development then frame7 almost vanished. Absolutely no background haze rectangles, no whole-sheet mist, no text or grid, alpha outside individual effects ZERO. Arcane Vanguard boldclean shapes with subtle limited glow. ROW1: Soul Storm: dark violet and green screaming soul vortex begins tight, expands in spiraling skull wisps, fades. ROW2: Raise Dead: skeletal hands and green soul motes rise from circular ground rune then fade. ROW3: Royal green magic casting seal appears in gold violet accents, builds then fades. ROW4: Lich green soul summoning wisps ascend and disperse. No characters or weapons.
